variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Use 'val' for read-only variables and 'var' for mutable variables.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
val i: Int = 1
val d: Double = 1.0
val b: Boolean = true
val s: String = "Text"
val n: String? = null
data_types.notes: Kotlin features strict null safety using nullable types denoted by '?'.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
val sum = 1 + 2
val eq = (1 == 1) // structural equality
val refEq = (obj1 === obj2) // referential equality

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
val max = if (a > b) a else b

val type = when (x) {
    1 -> "One"
    in 2..10 -> "Few"
    is String -> "String"
    else -> "Unknown"
}

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
for (i in 1..5) { println(i) }
for (item in collection) { println(item) }

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Single-expression functions can omit the return type and braces.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
val arr = arrayOf(1, 2, 3)
val intArr = intArrayOf(1, 2, 3)
arr[0] = 10
arrays.notes: Arrays are invariant. Primitive arrays like IntArray avoid boxing.

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
val map = mapOf("a" to 1, "b" to 2)
val mutMap = mutableMapOf("a" to 1)
mutMap["c"] = 3
maps.notes: 'to' is an infix function creating a Pair.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: try-catch is an expression. Kotlin has no checked exceptions.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Kotlin uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: Kotlin provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Kotlin uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: Kotlin supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Kotlin distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.code:
val name = "Alice"
val score = 95
val msg = "User $name scored ${score + 5}"
string_formatting.notes: Kotlin supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: Kotlin evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.code:
val r = 1..10 step 2
for (i in r) { print(i) }
range.notes: Kotlin represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: Kotlin implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: Kotlin models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: Kotlin manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: Kotlin represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: Kotlin provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: Kotlin structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
